## Improved
- **A clearer update window** Updates now open in Lupo's own window, with each change given a short title and grouped by what's new, improved or fixed.

notes: When Lupo leaves the prompt on your clipboard for you to paste, it now says so clearly ("Copied. Paste with ⌘V") and tells you where to paste it.
New Paste for Me button: one click and Lupo pastes the prompt into your current chat from then on. You still press Return to send.
Messages after Done stay on screen longer, so you have time to read them.
Right after an update, Lupo now shows what changed.
